# 租户 CPU 消耗

本节为您介绍 OceanBase 租户的监控指标 **租户 CPU 消耗** 。您可指定统计范围，查询租户在单个 Zone 或 OBServer 节点的 **租户 CPU 消耗** 数据。

## 指标介绍

租户 CPU 使用量 * 100 / 租户 CPU 分配量。

## 指标参数说明

| **指标项** |    **指标名称**    | **单位** |
|---------|----------------|--------|
| 租户 CPU 消耗       | ob_tenant_cpu_percent | %      |

## 计算表达式

sum(rate(ob_sysstat{stat_id="140013",@LABELS}[@INTERVAL])) by (@GBLABELS) / sum(ob_sysstat{stat_id="140005",@LABELS}) by (@GBLABELS) / 100

## 采集 SQL

  ```sql
  select /*+ MONITOR_AGENT READ_CONSISTENCY(WEAK) */ con_id tenant_id, stat_id, value from v$sysstat where stat_id IN (10000, 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004, 10005, 10006, 20000, 20001, 20002, 30000, 30001, 30002, 30005, 30006, 30007, 30008, 30009, 30010, 30011, 30012, 30013, 30080, 30081, 30082, 30083, 30084, 30085, 30086, 30200, 30201, 30204, 30205, 30208, 30209, 30212, 30213, 30216, 30217, 30220, 30221, 30222, 40000, 40001, 40002, 40003, 40004, 40005, 40006, 40007, 40008, 40009, 40010, 40011, 40012, 40018, 40019, 40030, 40116, 40117, 40118, 50000, 50001, 50002, 50004, 50005, 50008, 50009, 50010, 50011, 50037, 50038, 60000, 60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005, 60019, 60020, 60021, 60022, 60023, 60024, 60087, 80001, 80002, 80003, 80007, 80008, 80009, 80040, 80041, 80057, 120000, 120001, 120008, 120009, 130000, 130001, 130002, 130004, 140002, 140003, 140005, 140006, 140012, 140013, 190001, 190002, 190003, 190004, 190005, 190101, 190102, 190103, 190104, 190105, 190201, 190202, 190203, 190204, 190205, 190301, 190302, 190303, 190304, 190305, 190401, 190402, 190403, 190404, 190405, 190501, 190502, 190503, 190504, 190505, 190601, 190602, 190603, 190701, 190702, 190707, 190801, 190901, 190902, 190903, 190904, 190905, 190906, 191001, 191002, 191003, 191004, 191005, 191006, 191007, 191008, 191009, 191010, 191011, 191012, 191013, 191014, 191015, 191016, 191017, 191018, 191019, 191020, 191021, 191022, 191023, 191024, 191101, 191102, 191103, 191104, 191105, 191201, 191202, 191203, 191204, 191205, 191301, 191302, 191303, 191304, 191305, 200000, 200001, 200002, 200005, 200006, 200010, 200013) and (con_id > 1000 or con_id = 1)
  ```
